scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/validation/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/config/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/database/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: npm run build -w @almohit/database && npm run build -w @almohit/contracts && npm run build -w @almohit/validation && npm run build -w @almohit/config && npm run build -w @almohit/web
scripts.db:seed: prisma migrate deploy --config prisma7.config.ts && tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:setup: prisma migrate deploy --config prisma7.config.ts && tsx prisma/seed.ts
